scenario: A science desk editor receives a pre-release PDF (scientific paper or product announcement) under press embargo. A newsroom pipeline extracts the embargo statement from the PDF, resolves the stated lift time to an absolute timestamp, and generates a publication-readiness report indicating whether the story may be filed now or must wait.
info_flow: pdf-extract pulls the full text from the embargoed PDF including the embargo notice -> temporal-cortex-datetime resolves the embargo lift time to an absolute RFC 3339 timestamp and compares it against the current UTC clock -> reporting generates a publication-readiness memo that records the resolved lift time and a go/no-go filing decision.
